why_this_directory_exists: receipts written after the subject freeze are kept out of the frozen include-roots so the frozen row set and its digest cannot drift under a running checker. The earlier adjudication receipt inside verification/round-harness changed the digest and had to be excluded explicitly; that lesson is recorded here.

new_occurrence.partial_capture: 0 bytes stdout and stderr — the dispatcher timeout branch dropped them, which is the known reproduced defect; an empty capture is NOT evidence the lane did nothing
new_occurrence.why_it_was_slow: the lane was given the long original verification brief (seven required steps including a per-case coverage matrix and a 3-mutation falsification) and spent its budget reading; the same pattern that exhausted the earlier maker lanes

changes: brief narrowed to five numbered steps with a bounded case list instead of "every contract case"
RULE ZERO forbids ending a turn without the transport token; RULE ONE forbids permission probing and planning; RULE TWO forbids re-reading large files or dumping bodies

round-only diagnostic budget raised to 1200s AND the diagnostic trace enabled, so this attempt is observable while it runs — the canonical 600s gate and the acceptance oracle are unchanged, and the raise is disclosed here
the strongest-claim falsification is now pointed at named artifacts (entry maps, baseline entries, topic payloads) instead of being left to discovery
intervention_applied.why_remediate_rather_than_pause: the failure is budget exhaustion on an over-broad brief, not a gate refusal or a frozen-subject mutation; the same narrowing already converted the SECURITY work order from a nonce-less failure into a token-bearing PASS_ADVISORY, so the remedy has demonstrated effect. A pause here would abandon the acceptance step the order requires

error_class_update.pause_trigger: if this narrowed attempt also fails on the same exhausted class, or if the class keeps growing without a successful verdict, the VERIFY work order is paused and reported instead of retried again

claim_ceiling: a record of failure-class accounting and the remediation applied; it verifies no product behaviour and grants no acceptance
